rapport_notes: Calvin is friendly, conversational, and patient; uses the customer's name naturally and reassures her throughout; tone is warm but somewhat rushed given the scope of the move.
process_discipline_notes: No differentiators repeated; no silence violations detected (though opportunities for silence after open questions were limited due to the transactional nature of the call).

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Not present. Calvin launches directly into rate-quoting: 'So you're just moving a couple of pieces of furniture' → $204/hour, $510 estimate, no framing or trade-off.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked. No version of 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns' or equivalent appears anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no agenda established, so no concerns to probe.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Not covered. Customer mentions 'glass table' and items but Calvin never asks 'What items do you need us to be most careful with?' or mentions damage coverage / $2k protection.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: Not covered. No 'Who will be there to guide the crew?' or Meet Your Mover context given.
evidence_quotes.communication: Partial. Calvin says 'we're gonna call on Friday morning when we're on the way' and confirms 'they can give you a call when they're done' — day-before call, named crew lead (Ruth), and inbox updates are NOT mentioned. Only arrival notification covered.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Not covered. No mention of on-time performance or guarantee.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Partial. Calvin gives a range ('two and a half hour minimum... probably gonna be within the minimum') and personalizes slightly to the item count ('with the items being moved'), but does not anchor to a typical crew size / standard time block or give a clear upper bound personalized to the customer's scenario (third floor, elevator present, etc.).
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_lines: None hit. No 'commit to the rate' / 100k moves context. No 'estimate is a window because your move is yours.' No 'if crew beats it, you pay less / 15-min increments.' No self-prep tip. No 'does that feel fair?' + silence.
evidence_quotes.close_rate_lock: Not mentioned. No line about when the rate locks or locking it at booking.
evidence_quotes.close_explicit_ask: Not present. Call ends with logistics confirmation ('See you Friday') but no explicit 'Would you like our help with your move?' or equivalent closing ask — booking has already been accepted in the natural flow, so there is no close moment.

top_strength: Calvin quickly gathered all essential logistics (names, addresses, floor/elevator details, contact info) with clear questions, confirmed the booking seamlessly, and maintained warm rapport throughout a fast-moving transaction.
coaching_note: This call skipped discovery entirely (no quid pro quo, no agenda, no two-layer follow-up) and went straight to transactional details; the next move is to front-load the agenda question before quoting and probe at least one customer concern to a second layer, then use Stage 2 to deliver the differentiators that weren't raised.
